mapper.insert: insert into review( trade_id, from_user_id, to_user_id, score, content, tags) values ( #{tradeId}, #{fromUserId}, #{toUserId}, #{score}, #{content}, #{tags} )
mapper.select: select r.id, u.username, u.avatar, r.score, r.content, t.tags, r.create_time from review r left join user u on r.from_user_id = u.id where r.to_user_id = #{userId} order by r.create_time desc
